info.title: PostMind Studio internal API (for PostMind Core)
info.description: Service-to-service endpoints PostMind Core calls, mirroring Engagement handover 14.13. Authenticate with the X-Service-Token header (STUDIO_INTERNAL_SERVICE_TOKEN on Studio, at least 32 characters). Route /api/studio/internal/* from the private network only. Every operation is idempotent, so Core may retry it after a timeout, a 429 (honour Retry-After) or a 5xx. Bodies are capped at 65536 bytes. Responses never contain access tokens. GENERATED from the route handlers’ zod schemas — do not edit by hand.

post.summary: Register (or re-register) a Meta channel after Core’s OAuth token exchange
post.description: Engagement handover 9.5 step 7. Idempotent upsert on (organisationId, platform, platformAccountId): 201 when created, 200 when it already existed (the token is replaced and the channel re-activated). The token is stored envelope-encrypted and never returned. String fields are trimmed; unknown fields are ignored.

400.description: Body failed validation (details.issues: path + message, never values).

404.description: Not found — also the answer for EVERY path when STUDIO_INTERNAL_SERVICE_TOKEN is unset on Studio (internal API disabled).

429.description: Rate limited (STUDIO_INTERNAL_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MIN, default 600/min). Retry after the Retry-After header (seconds).

500.description: Studio error ({ ok: false, error: "internal_error" }). Retry with backoff.

503.description: Studio unavailable (deploy / load balancer). Retry with backoff.

post.summary: Push tokens Core’s nightly job refreshed (one, or a batch of up to 100)
post.description: Engagement handover 9.6 / 14.13. Single form: 200 { result } when updated, 404 when the channel was never registered, 409 when it was disconnected (register again to reconnect). Batch form { channels: [≤100] }: always 200 with a per-channel result (updated | not_found | revoked). A needs_reconnect channel becomes active again. Idempotent.

404.description: Single form: channel not registered; POST /internal/channels first.

409.description: Single form: channel was disconnected; register it again to reconnect.

429.description: Rate limited (STUDIO_INTERNAL_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MIN, default 600/min). Retry after the Retry-After header (seconds).

500.description: Studio error ({ ok: false, error: "internal_error" }). Retry with backoff.

503.description: Studio unavailable (deploy / load balancer). Retry with backoff.

post.description: No body. Wipes every token and disconnects every channel, engages the organisation’s kill switch, cancels scheduled posts and soft-deletes Studio data with a 30-day grace period. Idempotent: a repeat call re-applies the purge (catching anything created since), keeps the first graceUntil and answers repeated: true.

post.description: BACKLOG 15.E2, spec 7.14 / 16.2, A11.7. Body { organisationId }. In one transaction: the business’s projects are soft-deleted and stopped (project kill switch), its scheduled posts cancelled, its style memories wiped and its business-scoped platform tokens wiped. Everything else of the business is hard-deleted by the retention sweep after the 30-day grace. Idempotent: a repeat call re-applies the purge, keeps the first graceUntil and answers repeated: true.

post.summary: Attribute an Engagement conversation to a Studio publication
post.description: BACKLOG 15.E3, spec 8.8. Called by Engagement when a comment, DM or mention on a Studio-published video arrives. Idempotent per (publication, conversation): a repeat answers repeated: true; isLead is sticky (once a lead, always a lead). 404 when the publication does not belong to the named organisation.

400.description: Invalid publication id, or body failed validation.

404.description: No such publication for this organisation (or the internal API is disabled).

post.summary: Make a DRAFT video project from a PostMind post (“make a video from this post”)
post.description: BACKLOG 15.W1, spec 8.8. Studio fetches the content from Core (GET /api/internal/content/:id) and creates a DRAFT project (sourceType POSTMIND_CONTENT, sourceRef = contentId) the user reviews and generates in Studio. businessId falls back to the content’s own business. UNTIL CORE PUBLISHES ITS CONTENT API this endpoint answers 501 not_implemented and creates nothing — Core must not wire it before then.

400.description: Body failed validation, no businessId, or the content has no text.

404.description: Content not found for this organisation (or the internal API is disabled).

429.description: Rate limited (STUDIO_INTERNAL_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MIN, default 600/min). Retry after the Retry-After header (seconds).

500.description: Studio error ({ ok: false, error: "internal_error" }). Retry with backoff.

501.description: Waiting for Core’s content API: nothing was created (error: not_implemented).

503.description: Studio unavailable (deploy / load balancer). Retry with backoff.

CorrelationId.name: x-correlation-id
CorrelationId.description: Optional request id (letters, digits, . _ -; up to 128). Studio logs under it and echoes it; any other value is replaced by a generated one. Send the same value on every retry of one logical call.
The request id Studio logged this request under.
